file_id: Smt. Parwati vs Kamleshwar on 13 October, 2023

sentences.text:
Smt. Parwati vs Kamleshwar on 13 October, 2023
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Order Sheet
 Mac No. 1010 of 2019
 Smt. Parwati Versus Kamleshwar
Mr. Anil Gulati, learned counsel for the appellant.
Mr. Alok Nigam, learned GA for the State/respondent No. 2 & 3.
None for the respondent Nos. 1 & 4 though served.
Heard on IA No. 01 - application under Section 5 of Limitation Act for condonation of delay in fling the appeal.
There is delay of 341 days.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that due to sudden demise of husband of appellant No. 1, they went outside of State of Chhattisgarh for their livelihood and the copy of the award was kept by them in their home.
After sometime, when they returned back, they consulted with their local counsel and he advised them to fle appeal.

He further submits that the claimant Nos. 2 & 3 are minor and the amount of compensation appears to be on the lower side and looking to the nature of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, and the application may be allowed.
Mr. Nigam opposes the application and submits that no sufficient cause has been shown for delay.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and also considering the reasons stated in the application and the appellant No. 2 & 3 are minor and nature of Act of 1988, in the opinion of this Court, the appellants have been able to show sufficient cause for delay in fling the appeal.

Therefore,
the application is allowed and delay in fling the appeal is hereby condoned.
However, in order to meet the justice, the respondent should not be held responsible for interest if the amount is enhanced by this Court.
Therefore, it is observed that the claimants / appellants shall not be entitled for any interest for the period of delay of 341 days, in the event compensation is enhanced by this Court.
Admit.
Issue notice to the respondent No. 1 & 4 on payment of PF as per rules.
Call for the records.
List the case after service report is received in the month of December, 2023.
Accordingly, IA No. 01 is disposed of.

Sd/-
